version.changelog: Tightened the skill around fragile review workflows, reference stability, and layout drift after a stricter external audit.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: word-docx
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle contains only metadata and instructional documentation (SKILL.md) for handling Microsoft Word documents. The instructions provide legitimate, high-quality technical guidance on OOXML structure, style preservation, and tracked changes without any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Word/DOCX handling guide with no hidden execution, persistence, or credential behavior.

dimensions.detail: Access to document package contents is proportionate for DOCX work, and the skill does not request broad filesystem indexing, credential stores, external services, or account-level authority.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, remote payloads, or automatic install steps; related skill installs are suggested only with user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime guidance is scoped to user-directed document work and does not attempt to override system rules, change agent goals, or add unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, memory writes, or credential/session handling were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to help agents create, inspect, and edit Word/DOCX files, and the instructions stay focused on OOXML structure, styles, numbering, layout, comments, tracked changes, and compatibility checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to install for Word/DOCX workflows. It will lead an agent to inspect and edit document internals when needed, so use it with documents you are comfortable letting the agent process, especially when files contain tracked changes, comments, legal text, or sensitive business content.
